- Nour Odeh, Al Jazeera Correspondent

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
Thousands gather in Omdurman for Mawlid, the annual celebration of the Prophet Muhammad’s birth, as the city revives the zaffa procession. 

The festivities return to neighbourhoods affected by fighting after Sudan’s war turned Khartoum’s streets into battlefields in 2023; the army regained control of most of Omdurman in 2024.

Al Jazeera’s Almigdad Alruhaid reports from Omdurman, Sudan.

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
Vote counting in Zambia's general elections was suspended on Friday, then restarted hours later after the electoral commission said the security threat to the process had been contained.

Election observer missions monitoring the vote have responded. The head of the SADC Electoral Observation Mission, Samuel Tembenu, said the mission was not in a position to observe the counting and collation of results during the suspension, and urged all contestants and stakeholders to remain calm. EU observers are also concerned, calling the disruption a disproportionate response and saying it is for Zambian authorities to explain their decision. 

Al Jazeera's Haru Mutasa reports.
